mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicate a housing sector contraction that reduces consumer spending and business investment, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior 3-month averages, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a 3-month industrial production growth rate below 0.5% signals manufacturing slowdown and economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO growth <0.5% during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 275 (CPIAUCSL index) signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL >275, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate increase above 0.5% triggers liquidity reduction and equity valuation compression, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS >0.5% during tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases from prior 3-month averages, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.
